entries.zh: 亲密无间之友；好友相聚如两手掌相合
entries.en: friends joined together like the palms of the hands; close companions

entries.zh: 与人人皆交好；面面是佛，逢人都是朋友
entries.en: to be friends with everyone; all faces are Buddha, amiable to all

entries.zh: 和谐；朋友与友谊
entries.en: harmony; friendship, concord

entries.zh: 刎颈之交；生死兄弟
entries.en: sworn brothers to the death; friends unto death

entries.zh: 结交朋友；交友
entries.en: to make friends, to form a friendship

entries.zh: 和气；友好相处之友
entries.en: on good terms, harmonious; friendly

entries.zh: 与他相好；同他要好
entries.en: to be on good terms with him; a friend

entries.zh: 混入众人之中；落众〔西语栏残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to join the crowd, be among the group〔Spanish column corrupted; doubtful〕
entries.notes: source_L 西语栏为乱码式残文（detos d. contrados seau cred），仅依汉字与音写推断

entries.zh: 相得；彼此投合之友
entries.en: mutual affinity, to get along well; congenial friends
entries.notes: source_L 为缩略残文（avos destos），依汉字相得与音写判为相得之友

entries.zh: 厚薄；对朋友亲疏有别，厚此薄彼
entries.en: favoritism among friends, thick and thin; to value one friend more than another

entries.zh: 憨懃；至诚敦厚之友〔西语栏残缺，语义存疑〕
entries.en: earnest, devoted friendship〔Spanish column corrupted; doubtful〕
entries.notes: source_L 大面积残缺（grandiss. de am. chaprueba y de dignidad 难通读），仅依汉字憨懃推断

entries.zh: 朋友相互扶助、相倚为生〔西语栏残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: friends who help and support one another〔Spanish column corrupted; doubtful〕
entries.notes: source_L 残缺（hazen es pacos 难解），依汉字相倚与音写 sio ūa（相依）推断

entries.zh: 故旧；多年的老朋友
entries.en: old friends, friends of long standing

entries.zh: 故知；相识已久的旧友
entries.en: an old acquaintance, a friend of many years

entries.zh: 故友；老朋友〔西语栏附文残缺〕
entries.en: an old friend〔long Spanish annotation corrupted〕
entries.notes: source_L 长串附文（amigo falto y mientras come...）残缺难通读，主释义依汉字故友为定

entries.zh: 老交情；故旧之情〔词头残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: old friendship, acquaintance of long standing〔headword corrupted; doubtful〕
entries.notes: source_L 残缺且汉字栏仅录'腹'一字，côu húg 之对应词难定

entries.zh: 久相知；老友知交，彼此平等相待
entries.en: long mutual acquaintance; equal friends who know each other well

entries.zh: 平肩；地位相等的平行之友
entries.en: equals, friends on the same level, shoulder to shoulder

entries.zh: 平辈；同辈之友
entries.en: peers, friends of the same generation or rank

entries.zh: 平心和气；心平气和以交朋友
entries.en: calm, even-tempered and amicable; to keep peace in friendship

entries.zh: 浅交；泛泛之交〔释义存疑〕
entries.en: a slight or superficial acquaintance〔gloss doubtful〕
entries.notes: source_L 作 Amistad corta（短暂之交）而汉字'波及'常义为波及蔓延，四栏互证不完全

entries.zh: 亲爱；挚友或亲眷
entries.en: an intimate friend or a relative, dear one
